## Company
NA Engineering Solutions is an engineering, construction, industrial solutions, and General Order Supplies & Services business based in Lahore, Pakistan.

- Business location: 593 Block-A, LDA Avenue 1, Raiwind Road, Lahore, Pakistan
- Phone: +92 300 8596393
- Email: na.engineeringsolutions2023@gmail.com
- Official website: https://www.naengineeringsolutions.com/

For current service availability, project coverage, quotations, and specifications, contact the company directly.

## Main business offerings

### General Order Supplies & Services
The company sources general order and project-related requirements for business, industrial, commercial, and construction customers. Categories include:
- General hardware, tools, fasteners, and maintenance consumables
- Electrical items, cables, wiring accessories, and lighting
- Mechanical and industrial materials, pumps, valves, pipes, and fittings
- Safety items and personal protective equipment (PPE)
- Cleaning, janitorial, and facility consumables
- Packaging, pantry, office, stationery, IT, and miscellaneous supplies
- BOQ-based and specification-based procurement support

Primary page: https://www.naengineeringsolutions.com/supplies

### Engineering and technical services
- Engineering consultancy and project support
- Civil engineering and construction works
- Mechanical engineering, equipment, fabrication, and industrial repair support
- Pre-Engineered Buildings (PEB), industrial sheds, and steel works
- Industrial electrical works
- Mechanical and electrical supplies and services
- Utilities and facility maintenance
- Boiler water treatment chemicals and related support
- Seamless mild-steel (MS) and stainless-steel (SS) pipes and fittings
- Wastewater treatment plant (WWTP) supplies and services
- HVAC systems, ducting, ventilation, and maintenance
- Fire-fighting equipment and related supplies and services
- Safety and security systems
- Waterproofing solutions
- Industrial pumps, valves, and pneumatic fittings

Services overview: https://www.naengineeringsolutions.com/services

## How to request a quotation
For supply requirements, share an item list or BOQ, quantities, technical specifications, preferred brands or equivalents (where relevant), and delivery location. For engineering work, share the project scope, site location, drawings or dimensions, photos, and required timeline. Final availability, scope, and pricing should be confirmed directly with NA Engineering Solutions.

## Source guidance
Use the official website pages linked above as the primary source for current company information. Do not infer certifications, licenses, project awards, stock availability, prices, or guarantees unless those are explicitly stated on the relevant official page or confirmed by the company.
